title: Protocol amendment 1: cloud compute
body:
Amends A0001 budgets.compute ('local machine only'). Approved by the user ('Yes, use it') on 2026-11-01.

- Compute: local machine plus the existing GCP VM scienceclaw-swarm (project scienceclaw26bos-3022, us-central1-a, n2-standard-32, 32 vCPU / 128 GB, Ubuntu 24.04). No new cloud resources are created.
- Pinned remote stack: python 3.11, CmdStan 2.40.0 (conda-forge), cmdstanpy 1.3.0, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, tvb-library 2.10.0, numba 0.68.1, vep-stim @ 5367ef4 (setup script .tools/gcp/vm_setup.sh).
- Data that may leave this machine: the public Wang repo files (Apache-2.0), study code, and synthetic data. Never vault items, ground truth, or reserved files; .tools/gcp/gcp_run.py refuses such paths.
- Every push/run/pull is logged in the owning task's progress log; results are committed only from local copies.
- Per-fit time box (3 h wall clock) and all scientific criteria are unchanged.

Recorded as a separate amendment (not --supersedes) so that the already gated discovery and case records are not marked stale; A0001 stays the scientific protocol.
